property.description: Access Control functions do not panic under appropriate assumptions.

rules.name: grant_role_non_panic
rules.description: if: storage is setup, caller auth and caller is admin or has admin role then grant_role does not panic

rules.name: revoke_role_non_panic
rules.description: if: storage is setup, caller auth, caller is admin or has admin role, and role is not empty then revoke_role does not panic

rules.name: renounce_role_non_panic
rules.description: if: storage is setup, caller auth, caller has the role, and role is not empty then renounce_role does not panic

rules.name: transfer_admin_role_non_panic
rules.description: if storage is setup, admin exists, admin auth, pending owner can only be the same as new_admin, and live until ledger is appropriate then transfer_admin_role does not panic

rules.name: accept_admin_transfer_non_panic
rules.description: if: storage is setup, pending admin exists and pending admin auth then accept_admin_transfer does not panic

rules.name: set_role_admin_non_panic
rules.description: if: storage is setup, admin exists and admin auth then set_role_admin does not panic

rules.name: renounce_admin_non_panic
rules.description: if: storage is setup, admin exists and admin auth, and no pending admin, then renounce_admin does not panic
